shellCommands.command: ls -a && cat package.json && ls .agents/skills/gravity-ui -R | head -50 && cat AGENTS.md | head -30

grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json; find src __agent_eval__ -type f | head -30; cat src/*.tsx | head -80; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>&1 | head; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider useThemeValue useTheme Switch 2>&1 | head -50

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme && cat useThemeValue.d.ts useThemeType.d.ts useThemeSettings.d.ts ThemeSettingsContext.d.ts ThemeContext.d.ts index.d.ts useThemeContext.d.ts; cat useTheme.js

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat Switch/Switch.d.ts SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts | head -80; grep -n "onUpdate\|options\|value" RadioGroup/RadioGroup.d.ts | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && python3 - <<'E'
p='src/main.tsx'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("import { ThemeProvider } from '@gravity-ui/uikit';\n","")
s=s.replace("import { App } from './App';","import { App } from './App';\nimport { AppThemeProvider } from './theme';")
s=s.replace('<ThemeProvider theme="light">','<AppThemeProvider>').replace('</ThemeProvider>','</AppThemeProvider>')
open(p,'w').write(s)
E
cat src/main.tsx | tail -12; npm run build 2>&1 | tail -20
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -12; git status --short
